summary.notes: Shared guard model is CONFIRMED: both handlers use a nonce as the effective authorization gate without any capability or ownership check in the shown code. A stronger joined cluster claim is REJECTED. HR-001 remains UNCERTAIN on the 'guest-obtainable' element because the bounded evidence does not show public-page nonce exposure. HR-002 is closer to a RISK_NOTE because its demonstrated sink is only a fixed notice-dismiss transient.

suggested_actions.reason: Keep separate from the cluster. The primary files show a public REST route with nonce-only authorization at src/Integrations/OptInMonster/OptInMonsterIntegration.php:201-220 leading to contact submission at src/Api/Handlers/ReachApiHandler.php:99-100 and src/Api/Handlers/ReachApiHandler.php:242-279, but the pack does not prove that the localized wp_rest nonce at src/Integrations/OptInMonster/OptInMonsterIntegration.php:240-246 is exposed to guests.

Downgrade toward RISK_NOTE. The AJAX path at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:28 and src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:43-45 lacks a capability check, but the visible sink at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:58-60 is only a fixed transient write that dismisses a notice, not a comparable integrity or privilege boundary.

proposed_links.reason: Both handlers rely on nonce validation as the effective authorization gate with no capability or ownership check in the shown code: wp_verify_nonce( ..., 'wp_rest' ) in src/Integrations/OptInMonster/OptInMonsterIntegration.php:201-207 and check_ajax_referer( self::NOTICE_ACTION, 'nonce' ) in src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:43-45.

objections.reason: No stronger cross-bundle chain is shown. HR-001 routes into external contact creation through hostinger_reach_submit/post_contact at src/Api/Handlers/ReachApiHandler.php:99-100 and src/Api/Handlers/ReachApiHandler.php:242-279, while HR-002 only sets NOTICE_DISMISS_TRANSIENT at src/Admin/Notices/AddFormNotice.php:58-60.

The 'guest-obtainable nonce' part is not proven by the pack. src/Integrations/OptInMonster/OptInMonsterIntegration.php:240-246 shows nonce localization, and out-of-band src/Integrations/Integration.php:135-141 only shows that active hooks run when the integration is active, not that this asset is rendered on a guest-accessible page.

open_questions.question: Is the OptInMonster asset that localizes wp_create_nonce( 'wp_rest' ) rendered on public pages reachable by unauthenticated visitors when the integration is active?
open_questions.why_it_matters: That determines whether HR-001 is an unauthenticated contact-injection path or only a nonce-only route for already-authenticated users.

open_questions.question: Is NOTICE_DISMISS_TRANSIENT intentionally site-wide, or was dismissal supposed to be scoped per user or session?
open_questions.why_it_matters: If the global transient is intentional UX state, the missing capability check is weaker and may stay below reportable security impact.

missing_evidence.evidence_needed: A code trace or rendered page showing src/Integrations/OptInMonster/OptInMonsterIntegration.php:240-246 executing on a guest-accessible page, or equivalent bootstrap evidence that the asset is enqueued for unauthenticated visitors.
missing_evidence.reason: Needed to substantiate the 'guest-obtainable wp_rest nonce' element rather than only a nonce-only guard model.

missing_evidence.evidence_needed: A requirement or code path showing that writing NOTICE_DISMISS_TRANSIENT changes more than site-wide notice visibility, or that the transient should have been per-user.
missing_evidence.reason: Needed before treating AddFormNotice as more than a low-impact global UI state change.

expansion_attempts.reason: Validate whether active integration hooks and nonce localization are activated broadly enough to support the public or guest reachability claim in HR-001.
expansion_attempts.result: src/Integrations/Integration.php:135-141 confirms active_integration_hooks() runs when the integration is marked active, but it does not show guest-facing render context. No optional_files were opened.
